title: Continuous poll layer — 2026 cycle (line-by-line verified primary releases)
capturedFrom: primary pollster releases listed per entry (fetched directly; syndication is never the only source)
method: Every number below was transcribed from the pollster's own release (PDF or release page) or, for CNN/SSRS, from CNN's publication of its own poll with the SSRS methodology note. Field dates, population (RV/LV/adults), n and margin of error are recorded as published. Poll margins are converted to a Democratic win probability only for the side-by-side with Kalshi using the same logistic mapping as the 2024 poll backtest, p = 1/(1+exp(-margin/4.5)) — a labelled modelling choice, not a pollster claim. Aggregator readings (RealClearPolling) are recorded as aggregator readings, not as polls. Entries marked review:true carry toplines transcribed from the pollster's release page but their n / margin of error / field dates could not be fetched (publisher page blocked); they are shown with that caveat until reviewed. Session 7 (2026-09-20) rows: elon-2026-09-nc-senate, hpu-2026-04-nc-senate and harrisx-2026-08-generic (all carry methodFamily; HPU's 'moe' is the release's credibility interval, as its methodNote says); two pending items record what was verified but not transcribed. Session 8 (2026-09-20) rows: hpu-2026-08-nc-senate + hpu-2026-08-nc-house-generic (Poll 126, both with the credibility-interval label; the house row's kalshiDemTicker is null by design — see marketBasis), uh-hobby-2026-01-tx-governor + uh-hobby-2026-01-tx-senate (the Senate row is the median of six candidate-matched scenarios, stated in methodNote), saint-anselm-2026-06-nh-senate (new family random-cellphone-rv-panel, with the published marketGap), stetson-2026-04-fl-governor + stetson-2026-04-fl-senate (SENATEFLS-26 = the short-term seat), ppp-2026-07-nc-senate (methodFamily null by #49 discipline). The CIRCLE youth poll is an aggregator reading with D/R null (subpopulation, not a race), and CIRCLE YESI 2026 top-10 lists are independentPriors — neither is a poll.
policy: Only free, publicly available releases from school/academic research centres, established pollsters with published methodology, or the outlets that commission and publish them. Sponsored one-off polls without a methodology statement are not admitted. Nothing here is used to trade; the contest reads pollSignal only from the 2024 archive.

methodFamilies.note: Irregularity #49 labels. Every row added from 2026-09-19 (session 6) onward carries methodFamily; earlier rows are labelled where the release stated the design. Rows are never averaged across families without saying so.

families.live-caller-rdd: Live interviewers, random-digit-dial or listed sample (landline + cell).
families.voter-file-hybrid: Voter-file (registration-based) sample contacted by phone and/or text-to-web; live + online completion.
families.voter-file-mail-recruit: Voter-file sample notified by mail, completing by phone or online.
families.online-nonprobability-matched: Opt-in online panel matched/weighted to a population frame (e.g. YouGov matched to ACS).
families.online-optin-weighted: Opt-in online panel weighted to a voter file or census targets.
families.random-cellphone-rv-panel: Random cell-phone numbers drawn from a registered-voter frame, live interviews (e.g. Saint Anselm College SASC). Probability-based on the RV frame; distinct from RDD and from panel designs.
families.ivr-rdd-online-panel-blend: Automated (recorded-voice) calls to randomly selected phone numbers plus an online survey panel for households without a landline (Rasmussen Reports / Pulse Opinion Research field work). Probability-flavoured RDD phone core blended with a non-probability online panel; distinct from live-caller RDD and from pure online panels. Do not pool unlabeled with either.
